t: What is written before anyone is born
a: وَيُكْتَبُ عَمَلُهُ وَأَثَرُهُ وَأَجَلُهُ وَرِزْقُهُ ثُمَّ تُطْوَى الصُّحُفُ فَلاَ يُزَادُ فِيهَا وَلاَ يُنْقَصُ
p: Wa yuktabu ʿamaluhu wa atharuhu wa ajaluhu wa rizquh, thumma tuṭwa-ṣ-ṣuḥufu fa-lā yuzādu fīhā wa lā yunqaṣ
m: His deeds are written, and his trace, and his term, and his provision. Then the pages are folded, and nothing is added to them and nothing taken away.
